The number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the fore-brain of human, pig and mouse brains was investigated and the results were tabulated

I want to calculate the total number of elevated genes in each of human, pig and mouse brains
```{r}
Human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
Pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
Mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(paste ("In Humans:", Human, "In Pigs:", Pig, "In Mice:", Mouse))
```
Humans had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression
